messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=\"inference-az5\" severity=critical — high 5xx rate detected. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-1789011222 :rotating_light:
carol_oncall: acked. i'm on call, looking now. which region?
alice_ng: seeing spikes in 502/504 from az5 edge -> backend model shards overloaded. error rate ~18% over last 5m, traffic 2700 rps. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example.com/d/az5
bob_sre: grabbing logs. preliminary look: long tail stalls on model shard grpc connections, multiple evictions reported in node 7/az5.
carol_oncall: runbook: az-failover -> enable routing-fallback to az2, start controlled drain of evicting hosts. who can flip routing?
dinesh_pd: forwarding PD notes: Escalation policy triggered at T+2m. If not acked by infra in 5m, escalate to SRE Lead.
carol_oncall: i'm going to trigger canary divert and scale up dedicated pool. will post commands.
carol_oncall: ```
# switch routing policy to prefer az2 for inference-az5
redwoodctl route set --service inference-az5 --policy fallback --prefer az2 --dry-run=false
# scale up pool in az2
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool inference-az2 --replicas +6
```
alice_ng: note: customer-visible latencies for EU customers up from 180ms -> 520ms and failed responses up. adding mitigation: prefix-KV cache bypass might be hurting tail.
bob_sre: applied route change, verifying. kube events show host eviction from OOM on node-7.az5. patching qos to avoid eviction.
carol_oncall: pd notes: acknowledged at T+90s. escalating to bob_sre for deeper heap/cgroup investigation. cc @sre_lead
sre_lead: i'm on the call. if we can't stabilize in 10m, initiate failover and notify sales/ops for outbound comms to impacted customers.
bob_sre: running heaptrace and enabling extra swap limiter. logs: ```
[2026-03-15T14:34:12Z] node-7.az5 KVCACHE: eviction spike -> mem pressure
[2026-03-15T14:34:39Z] grpc: stream reset: resource exhausted
```
carol_oncall: customer impact summary to post: approx 12% of requests for EU-WEST routed to az5 experienced 5xx over last 6m. brief outage window, degraded performance for chat endpoints and streaming responses.
dinesh_pd: contacting on-call account reps for top-10 customers in EU for heads-up.
bob_sre: memory patch deployed to node-7, restarted model-worker on that host. still seeing some tail errors; starting controlled eviction of other suspect nodes in az5 to rebalance.
alice_ng: recommend enabling model-variant fallback for latency-sensitive routes while we heal (model-small fallback). proposing config change: 
```
app.routes.inference-az5.round_robin_override = [\"inference-az2\", \"inference-az1\"]
app.routes.inference-az5.fallback_model = \"gptx-small-v1\"
```
Would reduce quality slightly but remove 5xxs.
carol_oncall: approved. applying fallback.
incident-bot: automated action: routing policy updated; fallback model enabled for inference-az5. PD note updated.
bob_sre: after fallback, 5xxs dropped to ~1.8% and latency back to ~220ms for most. continuing to monitor for 15m.
sre_lead: handoff plan: carol to own immediate mitigation and monitoring, bob to investigate root cause (kernel OOM tweak / quantization mem blowup). assign postmortem owner: alice_ng.
carol_oncall: handing to bob for investigation. i'm keeping the PD incident open for now until SLA windows clear. :white_check_mark:
bob_sre: ack handoff. i'll collect heap dumps, core files and check quantization configs and recent model pull (pinned model version changed 12h ago).
dinesh_pd: PD: marked as acknowledged and on-hold. escalation stopped.
carol_oncall: update for customers channel: short advisory drafted: \"We detected increased error rates for inference requests in az5; traffic has been rerouted and degraded routes are running fallback models. We are monitoring and will send an update in 30m.\" sending now.
alice_ng: attaching quick metrics snapshot: total requests affected ~47k over 6m, errors added ~5.6k 5xx. top impacted customer tenants: tenant-a, tenant-b (both EU).
bob_sre: pulled model shard logs: large batch size spike correlated with a traffic spike at 14:28Z which saturated KV cache. working hypothesis: workload pattern + recent model param change caused memory blowout.
sre_lead: good remediation sequence. ensure we collect all state and mark incident severity/SEV2 in tracker. schedule war room if recovery stalls.
carol_oncall: T+30m status: system stable, error rate down to baseline. Keeping PD incident open until next 30m window.
incident-bot: Note: follow-up tasks created: ticket INF-1789011222 (postmortem), RUNBOOK update requested (kvcache backpressure thresholds), comms to affected customers.
carol_oncall: closing loop for now. thanks all. :pray:
bob_sre: final note: will run a canary of model rollback for the pinned model in a staging pool and run load test overnight.
alice_ng: postmortem owner acked. will schedule write-up and RCA by EOD tomorrow.
carol_oncall: incident closed in PD at T+2h after monitoring window. will update thread when postmortem published.
